name: Gallery behind the curtain
purpose: The walk behind Thunder Curtain Falls: a low carved gallery under the river where the whole south side is a moving wall of hot water lit amber from behind you, loud enough that nobody talks.

ceiling_profile.note: Rock-cut 3 m roof, 7 m of rock to the river bed (-44.6). The south side is an open arcade of basalt piers for x 21-37 behind the sheet; rock elsewhere.

portals.note: falls_stair_1 arrives from the south up the west wall.
falls_stair_2 leaves south through a rock-cut throat to the pool deck.
Open behind the sheet (lip 23-35), piers every ~4 m.

hero.why: The curtain seen from behind: a translucent, roaring wall of water lit by the lanterns at your back, with the teal pool glowing through it. It fills the whole open side and is the only bright, moving thing in a dark rock corridor.

anchored.why: Curtain side of the walkway (4.5 m drop to the pool).
Basalt piers every 4 m behind the sheet: the arcade frames the curtain in bays.
A niche bench on the back wall dead centre behind the sheet.

water_note: Spray and drip only (wet floor material); the sheet is w_thunder in b3_falls.

sightlines.see: Along the gallery: the amber lantern band on the left, the curtain glowing on the right, the exit lantern at the far end.
Through the falling water: a blurred teal pool and the warm deck lanterns, the roar all around.
Down the throat: the pool deck lanterns and, beyond, the teal glow of the rimstone through the shaft's east throat.

concept.match: The reverse of 19: from inside the gallery, the curtain fills the frame lit amber from behind the camera, railing and wet piers in the foreground, teal pool through the water.

lights.why: Dense warm band behind the sheet: the backlit curtain section is the brightest.
Marks the west stair mouth against the back wall.
Lights the throat where the walk turns down falls_stair_2.

mood.palette: amber backlight, white-gold water, teal glow through it, black wet rock
mood.mist: spray everywhere, floor wet and reflective

waivers.reason: The hero is b3_falls' 17 m sheet; from inside the 3 m gallery slot (floor -55, roof -52) only its middle 3 m band is in view, so the check's samples at 15/50/85 % of its height (-57, -51, -45) all lie behind the gallery floor or roof. The view of the curtain through the slot is the design.

lead_requests: graybox: close the gallery's south side with rock (y 76, -55 to -52) for x 8-20.5 and 37.5-46; open only x 20.5-37.5 behind the sheet.
